witnesses.title: Sample-exact timeline mapping and cue semantics under trim/gap/crossfade
witnesses.input: pure-Python integer-rational model: source 44100 Hz trimmed to frames [22050,44100), project rate 48000, 2400-frame crossfade, second clip 72000 frames; cue anchors at source frames 33150 (mid), 22050 (trim start), 15000 (in removed region)
witnesses.justified_expected: 44100->48000 is exactly 160/147, so 22050 and 44100 scale to exactly 24000 and 48000 project frames; mid cue 33150 -> 24000 + floor(11100*160/147)=36081; trim-start cue -> first retained frame 24000; in-gap cue -> None (must not be silently moved); joined length 45600+72000=117600; inverse mapping floor(12081*147/160)=11099 differs from true 11100 by -1 (forward mapping authoritative)

observed.stdout: cue_mid=36081 boundary_cue=24000 gap_cue=None total_samples=117600 xfade=2400 / inverse_hover_delta=-1 sample (forward mapping authoritative) / 2h_stereo_float32=2.57 GiB peaks_pyramid=5.49 MiB render_block=0.50 MiB / W-1 PASS

witnesses.scope_limits: Isolated arithmetic/bookkeeping contract only. No resampler, no decoder, no GUI, no file I/O, no real editor exercised. Proves the proposal §5 contract is internally consistent on exact integers, nothing more.

witnesses.title: WAV declared-vs-measured data-chunk contradiction policy
witnesses.input: two crafted RIFF/WAVE buffers (PCM mono 16-bit 48 kHz): consistent (declared 8 B, 8 B present) and contradictory (declared 1000 B, 8 B present); candidate-authored chunk parser
witnesses.justified_expected: consistent file: contradiction=False, frames=4; contradictory file: declared retained as 1000, measured clamps to 8, contradiction=True, frames=4 (declared size must not fabricate audio frames)

observed.stdout: consistent: {'declared': 8, 'measured': 8, 'contradiction': False, 'frames': 4} / contradictory: {'declared': 1000, 'measured': 8, 'contradiction': True, 'frames': 4} / W-2 PASS

witnesses.scope_limits: Validates the candidate-authored parser's policy in isolation only. Does NOT establish how libsndfile, python-soundfile or FFmpeg treat contradictory headers (that is proposed V-7).
